title: Five Popular Cakes Around the World
summary: Cakes can look and taste very different. They all begin with simple ingredients and careful steps.

cover.alt: An adult baker in a sunlit lived-in kitchen stands behind four cakes: a jam Victoria sponge, a cherry Black Forest cake, a strawberry cream cake, and a soaked tres leches square.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Cakes can look and taste very different. They all begin with simple ingredients and careful steps.

items.prompt: What cake do you think looks delicious?

blocks.title: Part 1: How to Make a Cake
paragraphs: First, mix flour, sugar, eggs, and butter in a bowl. Baking powder can help the cake rise, or get bigger. Put the mixture in a cake pan and bake it in an oven. After baking, let the cake cool, so it is not hot. Then you can add cream, fruit, jam, or icing. People often eat cake at birthdays and weddings.

images.alt: The same baker mixes flour, eggs, sugar, and butter in a bowl, then slides a pan of batter into a glowing oven.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: How to Make a Cake

items.prompt: What do you do before you add cream or fruit?
items.answer: You bake the cake and let it cool before you add cream or fruit.

blocks.title: Part 2: Victoria Sponge from Britain
paragraphs: Victoria sponge comes from Britain, or the United Kingdom. It was named after Queen Victoria. The cake has two soft sponge layers. Jam goes between them, like a sandwich. Many modern cakes also have cream inside. The top is usually simple, with a little powdered sugar. Baking powder helps this buttery cake rise and become light.

blocks.title: Check: Part 2: Victoria Sponge from Britain

items.prompt: What is usually between the two sponge layers?
items.answer: Jam is usually between the two sponge layers, and modern cakes often have cream too.

blocks.title: Part 3: Black Forest Cake from Germany
paragraphs: Black Forest cake is a German layer cake. Its cake layers contain cocoa, so they are dark and taste of chocolate. Cherries and whipped cream go between the layers. More cream, cherries, and chocolate can decorate the top. A written recipe from 1927 is kept in Radolfzell, Germany. Today, people can find this cake in cafes around the world.

images.alt: The same baker holds a sliced Black Forest cake showing cocoa layers, cherries, and cream.

blocks.title: Check: Part 3: Black Forest Cake from Germany

items.prompt: Which fruit is important in Black Forest cake?
items.answer: Cherries are the important fruit in Black Forest cake.

blocks.title: Part 4: Strawberry Shortcake in Two Countries
paragraphs: In the United States, strawberry shortcake has strawberries and cream with a biscuit-like shortcake or sponge cake. It is often a summer dessert. In Japan, the cake usually has light sponge layers, whipped cream, and fresh strawberries. Fujiya introduced this style there in 1922. It later became a popular Christmas cake. The two styles share strawberries and cream, but their cake bases can be different.

blocks.title: Check: Part 4: Strawberry Shortcake in Two Countries

items.prompt: What do the American and Japanese styles both have?
items.answer: Both styles have strawberries and cream.

blocks.title: Part 5: Tres Leches Cake in Mexico
paragraphs: Tres leches is a Latin American cake that is very popular in Mexico. Its name means “three milks.” Bakers soak a light sponge cake in evaporated milk, condensed milk, and whole milk. Small air bubbles in the sponge hold the milk, so the cake stays soft without becoming a wet mess. Whipped cream often goes on top, with fruit or cinnamon.

images.alt: The same baker pours milk over a pale sponge in a dish, with whipped cream and cinnamon beside it.

blocks.title: Check: Part 5: Tres Leches Cake in Mexico

items.prompt: Why can tres leches cake hold a lot of milk?
items.answer: It can hold a lot of milk because its light sponge has many small air bubbles.
